name: tokenized-vault
description: Tokenized vault dapp — ERC-20 vault with non-transferable shares, cooldown faucet, and live Sepolia demo. Foundry contracts + Vite/React/TypeScript/wagmi frontend.

paragraphs: ⚠️ Educational / testnet demo. This project is an unaudited demonstration built for learning and testing on Anvil (31337) and Sepolia (11155111). It is not for mainnet use with real funds. No security audit has been performed; expect bugs.

An ERC-4626-inspired tokenized vault: deposit an ERC-20 token, receive non-transferable shares priced by vault balance / totalSupply, withdraw back to tokens, and claim test tokens from a cooldown faucet. It is not ERC-4626 compliant — shares are not an ERC-20 token and the vault exposes no preview/convert view functions; the resemblance is limited to the deposit→shares→withdraw shape. The frontend is a Vite + React + TypeScript (strict) single-page app using wagmi v2, viem, and a custom connect modal — no RainbowKit or ConnectKit.
